subtitle: On a Battlefield of Sand, a King Raises a Sea of Stone and Water

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of Arnoraja on a rocky embankment above a vast shimmering lake, faint outlines of old battlements and hills of Ajmer behind
panels.action: Arnoraja stands in royal armour and cloak on the stone bund of a vast lake, wind tugging his banner, as farmers and builders work along the shore and the hills of Ajmer rise beyond the water.

dialogue.text: On the field where he once broke a Ghaznavid raid, King Arnoraja dammed a restless river and left Ajmer a lake that still shines today.

i18n.hi: जहाँ कभी उसने ग़ज़नवी हमला तोड़ा था, उसी मैदान में राजा अर्णोराज ने चंचल नदी बाँधी और अजमेर को ऐसी झील दी जो आज भी चमकती है।

panels.shot: epic bird's-eye over the arid plains near Ajmer, distant dust clouds of cavalry approaching a cluster of temples and groves at Pushkar
panels.action: From high above, lean horses and armoured riders from the northwest race across a dry plain towards the sacred groves and temples near Pushkar, while village smoke trails rise in alarm.

dialogue.text: In the mid-twelfth century, a Ghaznavid force rode deep into Rajputana, their dust reaching the sacred ponds and shrines near Pushkar.

i18n.hi: बारहवीं सदी के बीचोंबीच, एक ग़ज़नवी टुकड़ी घोड़े दौड़ाती राजपुताना के भीतर घुसी, उनकी धूल पुष्कर के पवित्र कुंडों और देवस्थलों तक जा पहुँची।

panels.shot: dramatic mid-shot of Arnoraja armoured on horseback, standard of the Chahamanas behind, pointing his sword toward the distant enemy
panels.action: Arnoraja, in chain mail and turban, reins his horse on a ridge above the plain, his face set and weathered, as his standard-bearer unfurls the Chahamana banner in the hot wind.

dialogue.text: King Arnoraja of the Chahamanas, grandson of Ajmer’s founders, rode out to meet them on the open plain beyond Ajmer.

i18n.hi: चहमान राजवंश के राजा अर्णोराज, अजमेर के संस्थापकों के पोते, अजमेर से बाहर खुली समतल ज़मीन पर उनसे भिड़ने निकल पड़े।

panels.shot: wide battlefield tableau showing opposing cavalry lines poised, shields glinting, a faint depression in the land hinting at an old watercourse
panels.action: Two mounted hosts face each other across a parched field, lances lowered; behind them, the land dips into a shallow basin where a slender stream snakes through cracked earth.

dialogue.text: The chronicler Jayanaka remembers a hard-fought field, near a shallow valley of the Bandi river, where spears met and a Ghaznavid raid was turned back.

i18n.hi: इतिहासकार जयनक ने कड़ी लड़ाई का मैदान याद रखा है, बनास की उथली घाटी के पास, जहाँ भाले भिड़े और एक ग़ज़नवी धावा लौटाया गया।

panels.shot: low-angle close-up on Arnoraja post-battle, standing amid trampled earth and discarded arms, gazing toward the shallow river course
panels.action: After the clash, Arnoraja stands among fallen banners and scattered shields, dust still hanging in the air, his eyes drawn to the quiet ribbon of water in the distance.

dialogue.text: Legend loves the clash of arms; the Prithviraja-Vijaya pauses instead on what Arnoraja saw after the din faded—the thin, wandering Bandi cutting across the scarred plain.

i18n.hi: कथाएँ तलवारों की टंकार पर रुक जाती हैं; पृथ्वीराज‑विजय तो देखती है जो अर्णोराज ने शांति में देखा—घावों से भरे मैदान को काटती पतली, भटकती बनास।

panels.shot: medium shot from behind Arnoraja looking over the valley, with farmers in the far distance leading bullocks along dry fields
panels.action: Seen from behind, Arnoraja stands on a rise as distant farmers coax bullocks over dry furrows, the sun harsh on the empty land between the hills.

dialogue.text: Ajmer’s hills held forts and shrines, but its people watched the sky each year. Rains were short, wells were few, and the Bandi flowed away, untamed.

i18n.hi: अजमेर की पहाड़ियों पर किले और देवालय थे, पर लोग हर साल आसमान ताकते रहे। बरसात कम, कुएँ कम, और बनास बही चली जाती, बिना बाँधे।

panels.shot: intimate close-up on Arnoraja’s thoughtful face, a faint overlay of water ripples reflected in his eyes
panels.action: A close view shows Arnoraja’s brow furrowed in thought, his gaze steady, as soft reflections of imagined rippling water seem to dance in his dark eyes.

dialogue.speaker: arnoraja
dialogue.text: This field has drunk war. Let it drink rain instead.

i18n.hi: इस धरती ने युद्ध का ख़ून पी लिया है। अब इसे बरसात पीने दो।

panels.shot: wide shot of a royal council in an open pavilion, Arnoraja seated on a low throne with engineers and ministers unrolling palm-leaf plans
panels.action: In a shaded pavilion, Arnoraja sits cross-legged on a carved seat as brahmin advisers and craftsmen spread palm-leaf diagrams and gesture towards a model bund made of clay.

dialogue.text: Jayanaka records the king’s decision: on that very battlefield, Arnoraja would raise an embankment, spread the Bandi’s waters, and bind Ajmer’s fate to a lake of his own making.

i18n.hi: जयनक बताता है राजा का फ़ैसला: उसी रणभूमि पर अर्णोराज बाँध उठाएगा, बनास को फैला देगा, और अजमेर की किस्मत को अपनी बनाई झील से जोड़ेगा।

panels.shot: dynamic wide shot of early construction, workers and elephants moving stone blocks across the valley floor, a line of surveyors with simple sighting tools
panels.action: Across the dry basin, long lines of labourers haul ropes, elephants nudge heavy stone blocks into place, and surveyors mark levels with staffs and cords under the supervision of Arnoraja on horseback.

dialogue.text: Great earthworks demand more than will. Surveyors traced gradients, builders cut and placed stone, and the king’s treasury turned from horses and wars to a wall of earth and rock.

i18n.hi: इतने बड़े मेड़ सिर्फ़ इरादे से नहीं बनते। नापतौल करने वाले ढाल मापते, मिस्त्री पत्थर काट‑जोड़ते, और राजा का ख़ज़ाना घोड़ों‑युद्ध से हटकर मिट्टी‑पत्थर की दीवार पर लग गया।

panels.shot: low, ground-level shot along the rising bund, men packing earth, ramming it with wooden pounders, the unfinished crest stretching toward the horizon
panels.action: Seen from the ground, men press layers of clay and rubble, lifting heavy wooden pounders in rhythm, as an unfinished embankment curves across the valley like a raw spine.

dialogue.text: Block by block, tamped layer upon layer, the Ana Sagar bund rose. The Chahamana prashasti remembers this labour as clearly as any campaign.

i18n.hi: ईंट‑ईंट, परत‑परत दबाकर अना सागर का बाँध उठता गया। चहमान प्रशस्ति इस मेहनत को वैसे ही गिनती है जैसे किसी युद्ध विजय को।

panels.shot: evocative mid-shot of Arnoraja personally inspecting a stone spillway, pointing while a mason chisels, clouds building in the monsoon sky
panels.action: Arnoraja stands beside a newly carved stone spillway, gesture firm as he directs a mason, while dark monsoon clouds gather above and the first wind stirs the surface of the half-filled basin.

dialogue.text: This was no simple pond. Channels, spillways and sluices controlled the Bandi’s moods, so that floods would not tear the new heart of Ajmer apart.

i18n.hi: ये कोई छोटा तालाब नहीं था। नालों, निकासों और फाटकों से बनास के मिज़ाज को साधा गया, ताकि बाढ़ें अजमेर के नए दिल को चीर न दें।

panels.shot: majestic wide shot of the first monsoon filling the basin, rain slanting down, villagers watching from the slopes as water spreads
panels.action: Sheets of monsoon rain fall as muddy water rushes from the Bandi into the basin; villagers on the slopes watch, half fearful, as the spreading sheet of water slowly covers the old battle-scarred ground.

dialogue.text: Then the rains came. The basin filled, the old field disappeared, and where horses once charged, the waters of Ana Sagar spread in a gleaming expanse.

i18n.hi: फिर बारिशें आईं। घाटी भर उठी, पुराना मैदान डूब गया, और जहाँ कभी घोड़े दौड़े थे, वहाँ अना सागर का पानी चकाचक फैला।

panels.shot: tranquil sunrise wide shot of the completed lake, fishermen in small boats, women drawing water, Ajmer’s walls and temples above
panels.action: At dawn, calm water mirrors the pale sky as small boats glide with fishermen casting nets and women in bright ghagras fill pots at the shore, while Ajmer’s walls and temples rise along the hillside.

dialogue.text: Around its shores, life changed. Fields found new irrigation, cattle new watering, and Ajmer’s markets and houses turned toward the lake that bore their king’s name.

i18n.hi: इसके किनारों पर ज़िंदगी बदली। खेतों को नई सिंचाई मिली, पशुओं को नया पानी, और अजमेर के बाज़ार‑मकान उस झील की तरफ़ मुड़े जो राजा का नाम लिए थी।

panels.shot: mid-shot inside a temple courtyard, Arnoraja overseeing sculptors working on a Shiva image, with an inscription stone being carved nearby
panels.action: Within a stone courtyard, sculptors chip at a Shiva image while another artisan carves neat Nagari letters into a slab, as Arnoraja watches with hands folded, a lamp flickering by.

dialogue.text: The same reign that dammed the Bandi also raised a shrine for his father, Naradeva, in Ajmer. Stone, water and inscription tied lineage, faith and engineering together.

i18n.hi: इसी राज में, जिसने बनास को बाँधा, अर्णोराज ने अपने पिता नरदेव के लिए अजमेर में देवालय भी उठाया। पत्थर, पानी और लेख – तीनों ने वंश, आस्था और इंजीनियरी को एक डोर में बाँध दिया।

panels.shot: ornate court scene mid-shot, Arnoraja seated beside a queen in Gujarati attire, with a Chaulukya envoy presenting gifts
panels.action: In a richly decorated hall, Arnoraja sits beside his queen in Gujarati dress, while a Chaulukya envoy bows, offering a tray of jewels and a sword as musicians watch quietly.

dialogue.text: Through marriage he linked Ajmer to Gujarat: Kanchanadevi, daughter of Jayasimha Siddharaja, sat beside him. Alliances, like embankments, held only as long as pressures were balanced.

i18n.hi: विवाह से उसने अजमेर को गुजरात से जोड़ा: जयसिंह सिद्धराज की पुत्री कंचनादेवी उसके साथ आसन पर बैठी। रिश्ते भी बाँध की तरह ही, दबाव सँभले तब तक टिकते हैं।

panels.shot: somber medium shot of Arnoraja older, looking out over Ana Sagar from a palace balcony, distant hills hazy
panels.action: An older Arnoraja, beard touched with grey, stands at a palace balcony, hands resting on the stone rail, as he gazes silently over the wide surface of Ana Sagar and the hazy hills beyond.

dialogue.text: By the time new wars flared with Kumarapala of Gujarat, Ana Sagar’s waters had already outlasted the first treaties, a quieter monument than any victory pillar.

i18n.hi: जब तक कुमारपाल गुजरात के साथ नए युद्ध भड़के, अना सागर का पानी पहली संधियों से भी ज़्यादा जी चुका था—हर विजय स्तंभ से शांत, पर टिकाऊ स्मारक।

panels.shot: tight, tense interior shot in a dim palace corridor, Jagaddeva’s silhouette behind Arnoraja, who is unaware, shadows heavy
panels.action: In a dim corridor lit by a single oil lamp, Arnoraja walks in simple court robes, unaware, while the darker silhouette of a younger man, his son Jagaddeva, follows at a measured distance.

dialogue.text: Yet the threat that ended Arnoraja’s life did not ride from Ghazni or Gujarat. Chroniclers state it came from within his own house.

i18n.hi: पर जो ख़तरा अर्णोराज की जान ले गया, वो न ग़ज़नी से उठा न गुजरात से। इतिहासकार कहते हैं, वार उसके अपने घर के भीतर से आया।

panels.shot: stark close-up of Arnoraja falling or collapsing out of frame, his crown tumbling, no violence shown, only shock on his face
panels.action: A close view shows Arnoraja’s face in a moment of shocked realization as his body slumps out of frame, his crown slipping from his head and rolling toward the edge of a stone floor.

dialogue.text: The sources speak bluntly: Jagaddeva killed his own father. A king who had broken invaders and dammed a river was cut down by his son’s hand.

i18n.hi: स्रोत साफ़ लिखते हैं: जगद्देव ने अपने ही पिता को मार डाला। जो राजा हमलावरों को तोड़ चुका था, नदी बाँध चुका था, वही बेटे की तलवार से गिर पड़ा।

panels.shot: time-lapse-style wide shot: Ana Sagar across centuries, old palaces, later pavilions, modern city edges and cranes faintly suggested along the shores
panels.action: Across the calm expanse of Ana Sagar, the shoreline shows layers of time—old stone ghats, Mughal pavilions, and the hints of modern buildings and cranes rising farther back from the water.

dialogue.text: Today Ana Sagar still holds Ajmer’s sky, even as courts debate encroachments and pollution. Arnoraja’s name endures here not in legend alone, but in stone and water that outlived his own bloodline.

i18n.hi: आज भी अना सागर अजमेर का आसमान थामे है, जबकि अदालतें अतिक्रमण और गंदगी पर बहस करती हैं। अर्णोराज का नाम यहाँ सिर्फ़ कथा में नहीं, पत्थर और पानी में ज़िंदा है, जो उसके ख़ून से भी ज़्यादा दिन टिक गया।

title_i18n.en: Arnoraja and the Lake of Ana Sagar
title_i18n.hi: अर्णोराज और अना सागर की झील

subtitle_i18n.en: On a Battlefield of Sand, a King Raises a Sea of Stone and Water
subtitle_i18n.hi: रेत के मैदान पर, राजा ने पत्थर‑पानी का समंदर खड़ा किया
